websites.label: Website development
websites.headline: Website design and development for Jamaican businesses.
websites.lead: Give customers a clear view of what you offer and an easy way to enquire. From Kingston, Jamaica, we build responsive business websites and improve existing sites, with scope, hosting and handover agreed before work begins.
websites.caption: Desktop and phone views of our website contribution with the Dancehall Archive & Research Initiative team.
websites.problem_title: Your website should help the conversation, not get in the way.
websites.problem: Customers should not have to piece together what you offer, search for a working contact link or struggle with a page on their phone. We start with the information and actions that matter to your business.
outcomes: Make your services easier to understand
Show relevant work and useful business information
Give customers a clear way to enquire
Keep what works when improving an existing site
websites.proof_title: See the work before you decide.
websites.proof: The Dancehall Archive website brings research, publications, events and initiative information together. Explore the case study to see the contribution and responsive examples.
deliverables: Organise approved business information around the questions customers ask.
Build responsive pages with clear navigation, agreed contact options and useful search basics.
Check links and forms, agree hosting and renewal responsibilities, and hand over the relevant access.
steps: Discuss your customers, current site, content and goals.
Confirm the quotation and scope, then review the pages together.
Check the agreed journeys and confirm who handles updates and renewals.
faqs: Do you build websites for businesses outside Kingston?
Yes. We work with businesses across Jamaica through online discussions and shared reviews. Any site visits, travel and in-person meetings are agreed separately.
Can you improve my existing website?
Yes. We can agree a review of its content, platform, backups and maintenance arrangements before recommending repairs or a redesign. A replacement may not be needed.
What is included in the starting price?

A responsive business website bringing together Home, About, Services and Contact information, with hosting for the term in your quotation. Final pages, features, domain costs, revisions and handover are agreed in writing.
Do you provide SEO and monthly statistics?

SEO setup, measurement, reporting and ongoing care can be scoped separately. Reports explain available evidence, actual enquiries and useful next actions; clicks are not automatically enquiries or sales.
Who supplies the content and owns the accounts?
We help organise your approved information. Content responsibilities, licences, domain ownership, access and handover are agreed before work begins.
How long does it take, and how do payments work?
Timing depends on scope, content and review turnaround. The quotation confirms delivery dates and payment milestones. We do not promise a schedule before understanding the work.

websites.service_type: Business website design, development and redesign

software.label: Software and web app development
software.headline: Custom software and web app development in Jamaica.
software.lead: Turn repeated data entry, scattered records and difficult reporting into a practical business application. Based in Kingston, we work with Jamaican organisations to agree the workflow, build the useful features and plan testing and handover.
software.image_alt: Custodia Registry dashboard with records and operational information
software.caption: Custodia Registry application example, using presentation data.
benefits: Build around the people using it
software.problem_title: A workaround can become the way everything works.
software.problem: Information gets entered twice. Approvals live in messages. Reports take too long to assemble. Before adding another tool, we look at the process and decide what a useful solution should actually do.
outcomes: Bring related information into one workflow
Make responsibilities and next actions visible
software.proof_title: Practical applications, built around real tasks.
software.proof: Custodia Registry connects record information, custody, access and review. Another Check-In App explores attendance and operational reporting. These examples show the kinds of workflows we can discuss for your organisation; product availability and deployment fit are confirmed separately.
software.proof_label: Read the Custodia application case study
deliverables: Map the current process, users, information, constraints and priorities. Decide whether configuration, integration or custom development is appropriate.
Develop agreed workflows and interfaces with review points. Specify permissions, validation, integrations and reporting where required.
Agree acceptance checks, the deployment approach, account access and documentation. Scope support and ongoing changes separately.
steps: Walk through the current work and identify what needs to change.
Set priorities, responsibilities, acceptance criteria and a quotation.
Review the solution with you, test agreed workflows and plan deployment.
faqs: Is a web app the same as an Android or iPhone app?

A web application runs in a browser; a progressive web app can add supported install and offline features. Our examples include browser-based business software and a mobile-oriented PWA in development. Native Android or iPhone apps, app-store publishing and device integrations need a separate feasibility and scope discussion.
Do we need custom software?
Not always. An existing product, a better process or an integration may be a more practical choice. Discovery should establish that before a build is proposed.
Can you work with our existing systems?
We assess available interfaces, permissions, data quality and provider restrictions before confirming integration or migration work.
Can you build web applications and internal tools?
We can discuss business web applications, workflow tools and operational reporting. Supported devices, offline behaviour and integrations are agreed for each project.
What will it cost?
Custom software is quoted against agreed scope, complexity and responsibilities. The business-website starting price does not apply to a custom application.
What happens after delivery?
Ownership and licences, hosting, access, training and ongoing support are set out in the agreement. Future changes are prioritised and scoped separately.
Can we work together remotely in Jamaica?
Yes. Discovery, demonstrations and review meetings can take place online. We agree access, data handling, supported devices and any in-person work before development begins.

consultancy.label: Technology consultancy
consultancy.headline: Technology and software consultancy in Jamaica.
consultancy.lead: Get practical help choosing a system, reviewing a workflow or planning a technology change. From Kingston, LearnTech Foundation helps Jamaican organisations compare realistic options and agree a useful next step before committing to implementation.
consultancy.caption: Illustrative structure for a scoped decision brief.
consultancy.problem_title: You need a decision you can explain and act on.
consultancy.problem: Perhaps a system is no longer serving your team, several suppliers offer different answers, or a project needs a clearer direction. We help separate the underlying need from the proposed technology.
outcomes: Prioritise a practical course of action
Identify ownership, dependencies and next steps
consultancy.proof_title: Technical experience with an operational perspective.
consultancy.proof: Bertland Hope brings experience across software development, systems, networks, teaching and technology operations. Explore the background and application work behind LearnTech’s approach.
deliverables: Review the agreed processes, systems, requirements and constraints. Identify the questions that need answering.
Compare realistic approaches and explain their trade-offs, dependencies and assumptions in an agreed format.
A plan for the next step
Depending on scope, provide a prioritised roadmap, requirements brief or implementation guidance with clear responsibilities.
steps: Share the situation, the people involved and what is getting in the way.
Confirm the questions, access, deliverables, fees and review points.
Discuss the findings, decide on priorities and agree who takes the next actions.
faqs: What can we ask for help with?

Software and platform choices, technology planning, service improvement, requirements discovery and implementation direction are possible starting points. The engagement is scoped to the actual situation.
Will we receive a written report?
The quotation specifies the deliverables. These may include an assessment, options comparison, recommendations, requirements brief or implementation plan.
Do you also implement the recommendations?
Implementation can be discussed and quoted separately where appropriate. You can also use the agreed outputs with your own team or supplier.
What are your fees?
Fees are quoted for the agreed scope and deliverables. We establish what the engagement needs before confirming price or timing.
Is support available online?
Online engagements are available. Any in-person work in Jamaica, travel, access arrangements and scheduling are agreed in advance.
consultancy.service_type: Technology assessment, software planning and implementation guidance
